title: LibAM: An Area Matching Framework for Detecting Third-Party Libraries in Binaries
access_basis: publisher record and full author manuscript
motivating_problem: Detect reused library areas when whole-library and package boundaries are unreliable.
general_principle: Build function-level area representations and align anchors rather than relying on names alone.
proof_or_performance_argument: Algorithm design is supported by matching rationale, component analyses, and comparative detection results.
practical_connection: Shows the practical upstream candidate-discovery problem that exact provenance certificates do not solve.
evaluation_breadth: Large binary corpus with comparisons and ablations.
artifact_strength: Author manuscript and implementation/evaluation detail are sufficient for methodological comparison.
narrative_sequence: Problem -> limitations of whole-library matching -> area model -> alignment -> evaluation -> threats.
lesson_for_this_project: Use a concrete running notion of region, compare to strongest practical systems, keep exact-byte scope explicit.

title: Automatically Detecting Incompatible Android APIs
motivating_problem: Android API behavior and availability differ across versions and devices.
general_principle: Combine static analysis and compatibility specifications to identify incompatible uses.
proof_or_performance_argument: Precision/recall and application-level evaluation connect analysis choices to actionable incompatibilities.
practical_connection: Demonstrates TOSEM expectations for Android-specific modeling plus empirical validation.
evaluation_breadth: Multi-app empirical study with baselines and error analysis.
artifact_strength: Detailed algorithm, implementation, dataset, and threats.
narrative_sequence: Motivation -> taxonomy/model -> analysis -> study -> implications/threats.
lesson_for_this_project: Separate language assumptions from empirical claims and report unsupported Android features directly.

title: Taming Reflection: An Essential Step Toward Whole-program Analysis of Android Apps
motivating_problem: Reflective calls hide targets from Android whole-program static analysis.
general_principle: Resolve reflective targets through constant propagation and instrument equivalent direct calls for downstream analyzers.
proof_or_performance_argument: Benchmark and real-app evaluation measure target recovery and downstream analysis improvement; the paper does not claim complete reflection resolution.
practical_connection: Shows why reflection can invalidate a closed static inventory and remains outside the present build language.
evaluation_breadth: Benchmark apps, real-world apps, and downstream static analyses.
artifact_strength: DroidRA implementation and author manuscript support method and evaluation inspection.
narrative_sequence: Concrete failure mode -> recovery method -> integration -> evaluation -> limitations.
lesson_for_this_project: State excluded mechanisms once, explain why they can invalidate inventory completeness.

title: Demystifying Hidden Sensitive Operations in Android Apps
motivating_problem: Sensitive behavior can be hidden behind framework and atypical invocation mechanisms.
general_principle: Model hidden operations and reveal them to security analysis.
proof_or_performance_argument: Empirical discovery plus static-analysis validation supports practical significance.
practical_connection: Shows that observed byte ownership is not equivalent to behavioral visibility.
evaluation_breadth: Broad Android-app study with categorization and validation.
artifact_strength: Method and dataset pipeline described; artifacts discussed.
narrative_sequence: Phenomenon measurement -> model -> detector -> application study -> threats.
lesson_for_this_project: Do not overclaim downstream security benefit from a boundary certificate alone.

title: Demystifying React Native Android Apps for Static Analysis
motivating_problem: Cross-language React Native structure fragments code and call information.
general_principle: Recover and unify native/JavaScript components for analysis.
proof_or_performance_argument: System design is evaluated on real applications and downstream tasks.
practical_connection: Illustrates why a complete Android front end needs more than JAR composition.
evaluation_breadth: Real React Native app corpus and comparative analysis.
artifact_strength: Implementation and empirical pipeline are documented.
narrative_sequence: Ecosystem gap -> unification architecture -> implementation -> evaluation -> implications.
lesson_for_this_project: Frame the current archive language as a reusable kernel, not an end-to-end Android solution.

title: Resolving Conditional Implicit Calls to Improve Static and Dynamic Analysis in Android Apps
access_basis: publisher metadata and accessible full text
motivating_problem: Android framework callbacks and conditional implicit calls are missed by conventional call graphs.
general_principle: Resolve implicit calls with conditions and integrate them into analyses.
proof_or_performance_argument: Static/dynamic downstream improvements and validation show practical consequences.
practical_connection: Provides a recent bridge showing continued Android-analysis emphasis on missing semantics.
evaluation_breadth: Application corpus, call-edge validation, downstream tasks.
artifact_strength: Recent TOSEM article with explicit method/evaluation structure.
narrative_sequence: Problem evidence -> conditional-call model -> tool -> evaluation -> threats.
lesson_for_this_project: Use contemporary closest work to bound claims and motivate authenticated build evidence.

title: ARCTURUS: Full Coverage Binary Similarity Analysis with Reachability-guided Emulation
motivating_problem: Binary similarity misses behavior when static coverage is incomplete.
general_principle: Guide emulation with reachability to improve representation coverage.
proof_or_performance_argument: Coverage, accuracy, ablation, and performance studies support the system claim.
practical_connection: Contrasts similarity-based candidate discovery with exact-byte certification.
evaluation_breadth: Multiple benchmark corpora and baselines.
artifact_strength: Tool/evaluation detail and ablations strengthen artifact expectations.
narrative_sequence: Coverage limitation -> hybrid principle -> architecture -> experiments -> analysis.
lesson_for_this_project: Keep reference methods honest and avoid presenting local byte equality as a detector benchmark.

title: Beyond Tests: Program Analysis as a Generalisation of Testing
motivating_problem: Testing samples executions while analysis can summarize larger behavior sets.
general_principle: Relate testing and program analysis through a common conceptual framework.
proof_or_performance_argument: The argument is conceptual and illustrated through analysis/testing correspondences.
practical_connection: Supports explaining certificates as set-valued semantic evidence rather than another heuristic test.
evaluation_breadth: Analytical examples and framework discussion rather than a corpus benchmark.
artifact_strength: Conceptual contribution with clear definitions and examples.
narrative_sequence: Unifying question -> formal/conceptual model -> examples -> implications.
lesson_for_this_project: Lead from a concrete ambiguity to the general principle before implementation details.

title: SEADS: Scalable and Cost-effective Dynamic Dependence Analysis of Distributed Systems via Reinforcement Learning
motivating_problem: Dynamic dependence tracking in distributed systems is costly.
general_principle: Use adaptive selection to reduce observation cost while retaining useful dependence information.
proof_or_performance_argument: Performance/accuracy trade-offs are evaluated at scale with baselines.
practical_connection: Offers a contrasting empirical systems style; it is not a methodological ancestor.
evaluation_breadth: Distributed-system workloads, scalability, cost/accuracy analyses.
artifact_strength: Detailed evaluation and ablations.
narrative_sequence: Cost problem -> adaptive design -> implementation -> large evaluation -> trade-offs.
lesson_for_this_project: Report resource behavior as measured evidence, not as a universal complexity claim.

title: Reliable Fix Patterns Inferred from Static Checkers for Automated Program Repair
motivating_problem: Static checker findings can seed repair but naive pattern mining is unreliable.
general_principle: Infer and validate fix patterns grounded in checker evidence.
proof_or_performance_argument: Large-scale empirical validation, baselines, and error analysis establish reliability limits.
practical_connection: Reinforces the distinction between trusted checking evidence and heuristic production.
evaluation_breadth: Repository-scale study with multiple checker/fix dimensions.
artifact_strength: Toolchain and datasets described; empirical artifacts emphasized.
narrative_sequence: Reliability gap -> evidence-grounded method -> study -> failure analysis.
lesson_for_this_project: Make producer/checker trust separation central and include adversarial mutations.

title: SEAL: Integrating Program Analysis and Repository Mining
motivating_problem: Static analysis and repository history offer complementary evidence but are often isolated.
general_principle: Integrate code semantics with mined evolution information.
proof_or_performance_argument: Evaluation measures benefit over isolated evidence sources and analyzes costs.
practical_connection: Motivates explicit evidence layers and cautions against conflating discovery with certification.
evaluation_breadth: Multi-project empirical evaluation with comparative variants.
artifact_strength: System and empirical protocol described.
narrative_sequence: Complementary evidence -> integration architecture -> experiments -> validity.
lesson_for_this_project: Separate upstream candidate evidence, build evidence, certificate, and downstream policy.

title: Research Directions in Software Supply Chain Security
motivating_problem: Software supply-chain risks span dependencies, builds, provenance, and governance.
general_principle: Organize open research directions across the supply chain.
proof_or_performance_argument: Synthesis argument maps threat surfaces and research gaps rather than testing one tool.
practical_connection: Places authenticated inventories and build traces in the broader provenance landscape.
evaluation_breadth: Broad literature synthesis and agenda.
artifact_strength: No single artifact; value is taxonomy and cross-area synthesis.
narrative_sequence: Scope/taxonomy -> challenges -> research agenda.
lesson_for_this_project: State what the certificate can consume from provenance systems and what it cannot authenticate itself.

title: Proof-Carrying Code
motivating_problem: A code consumer should validate safety without trusting the producer.
general_principle: The producer supplies a proof; a small checker validates it against a policy.
proof_or_performance_argument: Formal safety argument and examples establish the architectural principle.
practical_connection: Direct conceptual foundation for separating boundary production from replay.
evaluation_breadth: Foundational examples rather than modern corpus evaluation.
artifact_strength: Formal method; no modern replication package expectation.
narrative_sequence: Threat model -> proof architecture -> validation -> examples.
lesson_for_this_project: Make checker obligations explicit and smaller than producer search.

title: Formal Verification of a Realistic Compiler
access_basis: publisher full text and project documentation
motivating_problem: Optimizing compilers are too complex to trust solely through testing.
general_principle: Mechanize a semantics-preservation proof for a realistic compiler.
proof_or_performance_argument: Machine-checked proof plus performance/practicality evidence supports trust claims.
practical_connection: Sets a higher bar than this ordinary proof and clarifies the absence of mechanized refinement.
evaluation_breadth: Compiler benchmarks and proof-engineering experience.
artifact_strength: Long-lived verified implementation and documentation.
narrative_sequence: Trust problem -> semantic theorem -> architecture -> evidence -> limits.
lesson_for_this_project: Distinguish ordinary theorem proof, finite oracle, and implementation assurance.

title: FlowDroid: Precise Context, Flow, Field, Object-sensitive and Lifecycle-aware Taint Analysis for Android Apps
motivating_problem: Android lifecycle and callbacks frustrate precise taint analysis.
general_principle: Model lifecycle semantics with a precise interprocedural data-flow analysis.
proof_or_performance_argument: Benchmark and real-app experiments measure precision, recall, and performance.
practical_connection: Canonical evidence that Android claims require lifecycle-specific semantics and application studies.
evaluation_breadth: Microbenchmarks and large real-app evaluation.
artifact_strength: Widely used tool and benchmark ecosystem.
narrative_sequence: Android challenge -> formal/algorithmic design -> implementation -> evaluation.
lesson_for_this_project: Do not transfer JAR-fragment evidence to complete Android analysis.

title: Build Systems à la Carte
motivating_problem: Build systems mix dependency discovery, scheduling, and rebuilding semantics.
general_principle: Factor build systems into reusable abstractions and explicit choices.
proof_or_performance_argument: Equational/semantic reasoning and implemented models explain design trade-offs.
practical_connection: Supports freezing one composition language instead of treating “the build” as implicit.
evaluation_breadth: Comparative models and implementations, not an Android corpus.
artifact_strength: Executable models accompany conceptual analysis.
narrative_sequence: Design-space problem -> abstractions -> instances -> trade-offs.
lesson_for_this_project: Define worlds and builder semantics before discussing algorithms.

title: in-toto: Providing Farm-to-Table Guarantees for Bits and Bytes
motivating_problem: Consumers lack end-to-end evidence about software supply-chain steps.
general_principle: Record and verify signed link metadata for authorized steps and materials/products.
proof_or_performance_argument: Security design, deployment experience, and performance evidence support feasibility.
practical_connection: Shows how authenticated provider lists/orders could discharge the certificate’s completeness premise.
evaluation_breadth: Case studies and performance/security analysis.
artifact_strength: Open implementation and specification.
narrative_sequence: Threats -> metadata model -> verification -> deployments -> limitations.
lesson_for_this_project: Treat inventory authenticity as an upstream premise, not something inferred from output bytes.

title: AndroLibZoo: A Reliable Dataset of Libraries Based on Software Dependency Analysis
access_basis: full author manuscript and published record
motivating_problem: Android analyzers need a reliable evolving library catalogue.
general_principle: Mine declared software dependencies and refine identifiers into a reusable dataset.
proof_or_performance_argument: Dataset construction statistics and validation explain coverage and limitations.
practical_connection: Historical problem source; candidate catalogue is upstream of per-build certification.
evaluation_breadth: Large dependency-derived catalogue; no per-region build oracle.
artifact_strength: Dataset and construction process are public-facing.
narrative_sequence: Need -> collection/refinement -> dataset characterization -> limitations.
lesson_for_this_project: Explain the trust-boundary change without mischaracterizing catalogue methods.

title: Reliable Third-Party Library Detection in Android and its Security Applications
motivating_problem: Package names and hashes fail under common Android transformations.
general_principle: Build structural profiles from original SDKs to identify libraries and versions.
proof_or_performance_argument: Detection evaluation and security applications establish practical relevance.
practical_connection: Strong practical detector that the current exact-byte study does not outperform.
evaluation_breadth: Large app/library evaluation and downstream security cases.
artifact_strength: Tool methodology and evaluation are documented.
narrative_sequence: Detector gap -> profile design -> evaluation -> security applications.
lesson_for_this_project: Position certification after candidate discovery; do not call a name lookup “LibScout-like”.

title: LibD: Scalable and Precise Third-Party Library Detection in Android Markets
motivating_problem: Market-scale library detection needs both scalability and precision.
general_principle: Use feature-based clustering/matching suitable for large Android corpora.
proof_or_performance_argument: Market-scale comparisons measure precision, recall, and cost.
practical_connection: Highlights ecosystem-scale requirements outside the current bounded archive fragment.
evaluation_breadth: Large Android-market study.
artifact_strength: Algorithm and corpus methodology described.
narrative_sequence: Scale problem -> representation/index -> study -> applications.
lesson_for_this_project: Keep scale-probe claims descriptive and separate from market-scale applicability.

title: LibID: Reliable Identification of Obfuscated Third-Party Android Libraries
motivating_problem: Obfuscation and library customization defeat naive identifiers.
general_principle: Combine resilient signatures and matching to identify library identity/version.
proof_or_performance_argument: Evaluation across transformed libraries/apps tests robustness.
practical_connection: Defines a transformation tolerance frontier beyond exact-byte observation.
evaluation_breadth: Obfuscation-focused benchmark and app study.
artifact_strength: Tool and benchmark pipeline described.
narrative_sequence: Transformation threat -> robust features -> matching -> evaluation.
lesson_for_this_project: Reject unsupported transforms instead of silently inheriting detector equivalence.

title: ATVHunter: Reliable Version Detection of Third-Party Libraries for Vulnerability Identification in Android Applications
motivating_problem: Vulnerability analysis needs exact third-party library version identification.
general_principle: Use multi-stage structural matching to identify versions despite transformations.
proof_or_performance_argument: Version-level detection and vulnerability studies connect method to security use.
practical_connection: Shows owner identity, version identity, and vulnerability attribution are distinct claims.
evaluation_breadth: Library/version corpus plus real-app vulnerability analysis.
artifact_strength: System implementation and evaluation are documented.
narrative_sequence: Versioning need -> matching pipeline -> evaluation -> vulnerability study.
lesson_for_this_project: Avoid claiming legal/security attribution from first-winner provenance alone.
